messages.author: Chloe Nguyen
messages.text: Looking at D7 retention by week, the latest week is way lower than the rest. Should we be worried?

replies.author: Ingrid Solberg
replies.text: Probably not, it's maturity. Cohorts from the last 7 days don't have d7_retained yet (NULL). If you do SUM(d7_retained)/SUM(installs) the NULL rows still add installs to the denominator. Filter installs to rows where d7_retained IS NOT NULL. Formula is on *Metric Definitions*.

replies.author: Chloe Nguyen
replies.text: Fixed it, the latest week is in line now. Thanks!
